Introduction

W!TCHX (also stylized as WiTCHX and previously known as WiTCHES) is a five-member girl group under Inmedia and Artform Entertainment. They officially debuted on November 6, 2024, with the digital single "Blala".

The group began appearing on Inmedia’s website in 2019, but didn’t make a public appearance until Expo 2020 Dubai, where they revealed their name and initial lineup: Bella, Aya, Mago, and Mari. In April 2022, Bella left and was replaced by Mina, who also later departed as the group underwent several lineup changes.

After multiple delays and rebranding to WiTCHX in August 2023, the final lineup was set as Lucia, Mago, Mari, Niaa, and Mew. Despite plans to debut in 2023 and another postponed debut in March 2024, they finally released their first single in November 2024.
